title: Bedhead Attractor
description: The Bedhead Attractor is a chaotic attractor defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = sin(x \cdot y/b) \cdot y + cos(a \cdot x - y), y_{n+1} = x + sin(y)/b

title: Bogdanov Map
description: The Bogdanov Map is a chaotic map defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = y_n + 1 - a \cdot x_n^2, y_{n+1} = b \cdot x_n

title: Brusselator
description: The Brusselator is an autocatalytic chemical oscillator. This visualization integrates dx/dt = a - (b+1)x + x^2 y, dy/dt = b x - x^2 y with an Euler step.

title: Clifford Attractor
description: The Clifford Attractor is a chaotic attractor defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = sin(a \cdot y_n) + c \cdot cos(a \cdot x_n), y_{n+1} = sin(b \cdot x_n) + d \cdot cos(b \cdot y_n)

title: Fractal Dream Attractor
description: The Fractal Dream Attractor is a chaotic attractor defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = sin(y_n \cdot b) + c \cdot sin(x_n \cdot b), y_{n+1} = sin(x_n \cdot a) + d \cdot sin(y_n \cdot a)

title: Gumowski-Mira Attractor
description: The Gumowski-Mira Attractor is a chaotic attractor defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = b \cdot y_n + a \cdot x_n + x_n \cdot (x_n^2 + y_n^2), y_{n+1} = -b \cdot x_n + a \cdot y_n + y_n \cdot (x_n^2 + y_n^2)

title: Henon Map
description: The Henon Map is a chaotic map defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = 1 - a \cdot x_n^2 + y_n, y_{n+1} = b \cdot x_n

title: Hopalong Attractor
description: The Hopalong Attractor is a chaotic attractor defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = y_n - sign(x_n) \cdot \sqrt{|b \cdot x_n - c|}, y_{n+1} = a - x_n

title: Hopalong Attractor Positive
description: The Hopalong Attractor Positive is a chaotic attractor defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = y_n - sign(x_n) \cdot \sqrt{|b \cdot x_n - c|}, y_{n+1} = a - x_n

title: Hopalong Attractor Additive
description: The Hopalong Attractor Additive is a chaotic attractor defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = y_n - sign(x_n) \cdot \sqrt{|b \cdot x_n - c|}, y_{n+1} = a - x_n

title: Hopalong Attractor Sinusoidal
description: The Hopalong Attractor (Sinusoidal) is a chaotic attractor that replaces the square-root term with a sine, blending periodic motion with fractal structure.

title: Gingerbread Man
description: The Gingerbread Man (or Gingerbreadman) map is a chaotic 2D system defined by x_{n+1} = 1 - y_n + |x_n|, y_{n+1} = x_n. Its orbit often resembles a gingerbread figure.

title: Ikeda Map
description: The Ikeda Map is a chaotic map defined by the following equations: x_{n+1} = 1 + c \cdot (x_n \cdot cos(t) - y_n \cdot sin(t)), y_{n+1} = c \cdot (x_n \cdot sin(t) + y_n \cdot cos(t))

title: Lorenz Attractor
description: Classic 3D Lorenz system rendered as a GPU line trail (green→white): dx/dt = σ(y-x), dy/dt = x(ρ-z)-y, dz/dt = xy-βz with σ=10, ρ=28, β=8/3.

title: Mandelbrot Set
description: The Mandelbrot Set is defined by iterating z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c for complex c; the set is those c for which the sequence remains bounded.

title: Julia Set
description: Julia sets fix a complex constant c and iterate z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c over starting points z₀. Each c yields a different connected or dusty fractal.

title: Sierpiński Triangle
description: GPU Sierpiński gasket with scroll-zoom and drag-pan. Each pixel tests barycentric membership through recursive corner remaps until a void or max depth. Depth is screen-capped to avoid sparkles.

title: Calabi–Yau Manifold
description: Hanson 3D projection of a 2-real slice of the Fermat quintic z₁ⁿ + z₂ⁿ = 1 (n=5). Lit mesh of all n×n Riemann patches; not the full 6-real Calabi–Yau 3-fold.

title: Gyroid
description: Schoen gyroid: triply periodic minimal surface meshed from sin x cos y + sin y cos z + sin z cos x = t on a 2π cell.

title: Barth Sextic
description: Barth’s degree-6 algebraic surface with icosahedral symmetry. Affine chart meshed from the golden-ratio implicit; 65 ordinary double points.

title: Schwarz P
description: Schwarz primitive (P): triply periodic minimal surface meshed from cos x + cos y + cos z = t on a 2π cell.

title: Dini's Surface
description: Dini’s surface: a pseudospherical helicoid (twisted tractrix). Parametric mesh with radius a and twist b.

title: Roman Surface
description: Steiner’s Roman surface: a self-intersecting immersion of the real projective plane RP², meshed from the standard trigonometric parametrization.

title: Enneper Surface
description: Enneper’s minimal surface from the classical polynomial parametrization on a square UV domain. Lit mesh; span sets |u|,|v| so the self-intersections read.

title: Boy's Surface
description: Morin–Apéry immersion of the real projective plane RP² in R³. A triple point and self-intersections; not an embedding.

title: Boy Jury · Bryant
description: Jury: Bryant–Kusner lit mesh of Boy’s surface. Contrast with Morin–Apéry on /boy_surface.

title: Boy Jury · Points
description: Temporary jury: Morin–Apéry Boy surface as classic points/dots (not mesh).

title: Boy Jury · Lines
description: Jury line-scan of Morin–Apéry Boy’s surface — legacy GPU line trail for render-mode comparison.
